# Anomalies: <puzzle>

Things in this puzzle that are odd and not yet explained. An anomaly is an
observation with no action attached; actionable hypotheses live in `leads.md`.

Status values: `unexplained`, `promoted` (now tracked in `leads.md`),
`explained` (moved to `facts.md`), `dismissed` (shown to be an artifact, with
the reasoning kept below).

Nothing is ever deleted from this file. A dismissed anomaly is worth more than
a missing one, because the next reader would otherwise notice it again and
repeat the work.
